default_prompt:
Transcribe this audio recording of a university lecture.
- Write down everything that is said, in the language it is spoken (Vietnamese, English, or a mix of both). Do not translate.
- Add punctuation and paragraph breaks so the text is easy to read.
- Do not add a title, summary, timestamps, speaker labels, or any comments of your own.
- If a part cannot be heard clearly, write [không nghe rõ].
- If there is no speech at all, return an empty response.
Return only the transcript as plain text.
